source: Reproduced from MissionSO, MissionManager, WaypointManager, TriggerEvaluator, ScoreManager and existing settings; not executable Unity code

missionFlow.onCorrectAnswer: mark task complete -> show completion title and narrative -> wait configured delay -> award task points -> advance
missionFlow.onWrongAnswer: show error -> subtract configured points -> retry
missionFlow.onMissionComplete: award mission bonus; emit completion event, allowing owning mission timeline block to finish
missionFlow.progressStorage: User-device runtime state, NOT content JSON (Unity previously used PlayerPrefs for GameScore)

gps.zoneEvents: fire when a specific zone is entered and its per-zone confirmation delay is met
gps.missionGpsTask: complete when its waypoint emits requiredZone event
gps.notes: Zone 3 precision at 5–7 m must be verified outdoors; web and AR must not assume the legacy altitude is geoid/ground height.

answers.multipleChoice: 0-based correctIndex, two choices or flexible three/four-choice layout
answers.proposedFutureRule: normalize Cyrillic/Latin, trim whitespace and allow editorially reviewed alternative answers (not yet active)

events.notes: Some group-level boolean semantics are inherited from the old implementation and require replay testing; port the event intent, not stale incidental Unity state.

ar.capture: guided_overlay_then_2d_hotspot; automated tower/image detection only after site test
ar.safety: do not force the player into traffic or to exact 5-7m position
